about: RAND (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 15; ADR-0180): Windows Excel 16.0.20430.20092, en-GB; October 3 observations. A draw has no Value Excel's could be compared with, so only the cases with one outcome are here: the samples (RAND-001, 002, 005) are the contract tests' (RandomTests), with a fixed Sheet Seed. The harness gives every case's Sheet a seed, as ExSheet does.

cases.description: Two calls do not share one value
